acceptance: PlatformOptimizationConfiguration round-trips a spark map through to_dict/from_dict and an empty or omitted map serialises to the exact pre-change dict (hash-identity test against a pre-change digest for default config).
Bare and prefixed key forms produce an identical requested_config_hash; a map with both forms of one key raises a clear error.
Static, core, adapter-owned and credential-shaped keys are rejected at config load with an actionable message; non-scalar values and `spark:` with no value are handled as specified.
Changing only the spark map changes requested_config_hash but not the physical-drift marker or database-reuse decision; existing databases still reuse (test via TuningMetadata paths in metadata.py).
A tuned bundle with a non-empty spark map lists a session-config tuning type in the requested/types-present output.
uv run -- pytest tests/unit/core/tuning -q passes, including test_platform_identity_keys.py and test_capability_source_drift.py unchanged.

description:
Users who tune Spark expect to set Spark session settings in BenchBox tuning YAML. Today PlatformOptimizationConfiguration (benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py ~L1018-1180) has no `spark` field and from_dict() silently drops a `spark:` key, while the run still prints a success message. Decision: tuning config is the right home; model is an open `spark: dict` map with a curated catalog for discovery and templates, not an allowlist (Spark/Gluten flags change faster than BenchBox releases). Keys are canonicalised to fully qualified `spark.*` at PARSE time (not apply time), so `sql.shuffle.partitions` and `spark.sql.shuffle.partitions` hash identically in requested_config_hash (ADR-001). Prior art: conditional omission of `physical_rendering_id` in to_dict() (interface.py ~L1148); `_non_default_platform_optimizations` (core/results/schema.py ~L1331) diffs against defaults and relies on the default having no `spark` key.

Design (from adversarial review of the plan, accepted findings R1, R2, R4, R6, R7):
- Add `spark: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)`. to_dict() omits it when empty; explicit `spark: {}` and omitted must hash the same.
- Parse strictly: coerce YAML `spark:` None to {}; reject non-mapping; reject a map holding both bare and prefixed forms of one key; values limited to bool/int/float/str; booleans lower-cased to "true"/"false" (the OLAP helper writes lowercase, so ledger text must match); reject None, list, dict values.
- Reject at config load: static SQL keys that spark.conf.set cannot change (spark.sql.extensions, spark.sql.warehouse.dir, spark.sql.catalog.*), core keys (spark.driver.*, spark.executor.*), adapter-owned keys (spark.py ~L470-499 table_format keys; velox.py ~L395-398 plugins/shuffle.manager/offHeap), and credential-shaped keys (secret, password, token, credential, access.key; e.g. spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.secret.key). Error text names the key and the supported alternative. Credentials in the requested block or ledger SET text would otherwise leak into published bundles.
- metadata.py (~L307, L436, L463) hashes the whole platform_optimizations dict into the physical-drift marker. Exclude `spark` from that marker payload but keep it in requested_config_hash. Session state is not physical layout; without this, changing shuffle.partitions would raise "Platform-optimization configuration drift" and force a full reload.
- results/schema.py `_tuning_types_present` (~L1380) only recognises `*_enabled` keys; make a non-empty spark map report a session-config tuning type so the ADR-002 disjoint-mechanism warning can fire. Do not add a TuningType enum member unless implementation shows it is unavoidable.
